evidence: Validation label and changes to `src/compressor.h`, which handles UTXO script serialization and deserialization for chainstate storage.
rationale: Fixes a chainstate integrity hazard where decompression failure could turn an unspendable script into an anyone-can-spend script. Commit 5500521f8b notes that `ScriptCompression::Unser` previously ignored `DecompressScript` failures, leaving scripts empty without surfacing an error, which under corruption turns an unspendable off-curve P2PK into an anyone-can-spend script.
